product_metadata.title: Glow in The Dark Throw Blanket Star Moon Pattern Flannel Fleece Blanket for Kids Boys Girls Toddlers, Premium Super Soft Fuzzy Fluffy Plush Furry Throw Blanket,50" x 60"
features: ✪GLOW IN THE DARK DESIGN: Shine in the dark, people seem to be in the mysterious universe. From then on, there is no need to worry about strong lights affecting sleep, and no longer afraid of dark night.

✪MATERIAL&DESIGN:The luminous microfiber blanket is incredibly soft for maximum comfort. The fluffy fabric of the blanket will feel amazing on your skin and it will never itch or irritate you, so it’s perfect for children and people with sensitive skin.
✪SIZES : The size of throw blanket is 50 inch × 60 inch.
✪MULTI-FUNCTIONAL : You can take it for daily use when lying on the sofa, bed, couch or car. The ultra-soft material also makes it a perfect lap blanket.

✪ATTENTION MATTERS : Simply expose the blanket under a bright light source or sunlight for 10 minutes then take it into a dark room to see the magic.Gentle wash below 30¨H, easy to store, crease resistant, fade resistant and no hair loss.
description: Glowing in Darkness, Mysterious and Interesting

With a special illuminating process,The more the blanket exposed to light, the brighter it glows in the dark. In addition, the luminescent materials we use are not harmful to the body. It will not influence children’s normal rest time and sleep.

The sizes of 50 × 60 children's blanket are multifunctional. It can be adopted to the needs of each user. For example, it can be placed underneath or on the body, in the car, on the bed, be used for pets, and it is also very convenient to take outdoors and is portable for trips.

The microfiber blanket is made with premium quality polyester that is incredibly durable so it can stay flawless no matter what. The blanket is machine washable and it will not shed or pill for perfect results and maximum convenience.
This beautiful blanket is very soft and warm so you can use it all year long to get cozy and comfy in bed or while watching TV on the couch with your loved ones.
